policy.activity_cohort: each valid 2025 endpoint independently; compound IDs share unit weight
policy.auxiliary_sources: all registered datasets normalized; documents catalogued; mirrors verified once
policy.census: all geographic levels retained; AGEB totals are a separate non-additive view
policy.cycling: layers stay separate; total layer not concatenated with component layers
policy.denue: snapshot 2026 retained and flagged; registration date is not an update timestamp
policy.gtfs: optional nulls and times beyond24h allowed; foreign keys checked; service-year flag
policy.incidents: 2025 analytical cohort; historical/out-of-domain rows retained in quarantine
policy.missing_values: preserve legitimate nulls and suppression; never blanket fill/drop
policy.processed_at: UTC epoch pinned when the immutable manifest is created
policy.ssc: victim records retained; repeated labels flagged, not inferred to be duplicated events
policy.station_identity: GBFS physical record; first short_name component is primary; all components are explicit aliases
policy.trip_cohort: both endpoints valid 2025, known station identifiers, nullable integer age
